description: PRIMARY LOOKUP — use this first whenever the user names a person, company, or place. Searches clients AND their contacts together: client/company names, contact first/last names, titles, email addresses, phone numbers, and street/city/state/zip. A name that isn't a client is very often a contact (e.g. a teacher or planner) attached to one — this finds those where a plain client search would not. Multi-word queries match all words. Pass include='notes' to search the free-text NOTES instead (per-date gig notes, booking comments and internal manager notes, your calendar notes) — e.g. to find the gig whose note mentions parking.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (integer; default varies, cap ~100).

q.description: Search text; with multiple words, all must match.
